Large Rock Mineral Collection Bundle Good and Beautiful Educational Box
This large rock and mineral collection bundle includes the Good and Beautiful branded educational specimen box with 9 labeled compartments featuring igneous, sedimentary, metamorphic, and mineral samples such as mica, quartz, and pyrite. Also included is a French-labeled display case with 24 compartments containing various tumbled and raw stones like Microcline, Labradorite, Cornaline, Jaspe, Amazonite, Rhodonite, Calcite, Dolomie, Gabbro, and Apatite in a bamboo-framed glass-covered box. Items show typical used and handled condition consistent with an educational or hobbyist rock collection. Specimens vary in size from small chips to palm-sized pieces. This collection is suitable for geology enthusiasts, collectors, or educational purposes.
